summary: Both failure groups involve negative Dec values with padding: StrCat formats them incorrectly for zero and space padding, while Substitute misplaces the sign for space padding. The excerpts show Substitute has its own Dec formatter, but do not include the complete Dec contract or the StrCat formatting implementation. Please provide those current-source sections to determine whether one shared formatting rule or separate bugs explain the failures.
hypotheses: The Dec formatting path used by StrCat places the minus sign after padding for zero fill and before padding for space fill.
Substitute's separate Arg(Dec) formatter applies the wrong sign placement when padding negative values, especially with space fill.
